artifact.canonical_name: ShareLock: A Stealthy Multi-Tool Threshold Poisoning Attack Against MCP

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.27027v1

claims.text: The authors introduce ShareLock, a threshold-based multi-tool poisoning attack for MCP ecosystems.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.target: verify threat model and MCP assumptions
targets.finding: ShareLock models MCP tool-poisoning across multiple tools, using threshold secret sharing to distribute a hidden instruction and a reconstruction trigger; the threat model assumes multiple tool descriptions can cooperatively contribute to an attack.
